About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.

As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

Position Summary

You’ll manage the support of a mid-large scale product, working closely with our engineers, designers and government partners to triage issues and distill them into clear, actionable tickets for the team. You'll be available to tackle Priority one issues as they arise. You'll also work with the team to continually improve on our response and support of the system and build close working relationships with a variety of people, including engineers, client stakeholders, and partner vendors.

You think holistically and understand how the details of the project fit into the bigger picture, and take pride in working through highly ambiguous situations to deliver value to users. You have a strong bias towards action when faced with incomplete information, and communicate transparently to build consensus internally and externally.

What you'll do

Serve as a primary connection between government stakeholders and the Nava team, managing the agile ceremonies , estimating effort and capacity, triaging production incidents, setting delivery expectations, tracking and communicating progress, and removing blockers as they arise
Proactively build and maintain strong relationships with your Nava teammates, government stakeholders, contractors, and cross-functional partners
Develop a strong understanding of the team’s objectives, systems, and capabilities to inform project priorities and help resolve issues effectively
Coordinate across multiple scrum teams to drive alignment across complex ecosystems and support successful outcomes
Provide clear, accurate, and timely reporting on risks, progress, successes, challenges, and outcomes
Monitor team velocity and sprint commitment reliability, and continuously improve the team’s processes for planning, organizing, and delivering work
Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning, embrace change, and ask thoughtful questions to better understand business needs and technical capabilities
Be part of a rotation of Project Managers who lead production releases and incident response approximately one week per month, on top of normal Agile Scrum duties for your teams. If a high-priority incident arises during your rotation, you may need to work extra hours outside of the normal work day

Required Skills

5+ years of experience as a Project Manager, Delivery Manager, Scrum Master, Product Manager, or similar role in a complex software development environment with multiple stakeholders
3+ years of experience leading Agile Scrum teams, including facilitating ceremonies and supporting effective team delivery
Ability to serve as Scrum Master for two concurrent and highly technical workstreams , such as cloud infrastructure and payments processing
Direct, hands-on experience using Agile performance metrics to monitor and improve team performance, including velocity, sprint commitment reliability, capacity planning, and backlog health
Experience using and managing engineering ticketing systems, with a strong focus on tracking issues through resolution and maintaining clear, thorough documentation. Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) and Confluence is preferred
Demonstrated experience leading fast-paced, complex projects involving multiple milestones, dependencies, integrations, and significant risk, uncertainty, or scale
Experience working collaboratively across Product, Design, and Engineering teams in a multidisciplinary environment, with a focus on maintaining clear, consistent, and fast communication
Experience with Agile frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe, and familiarity with Agile development practices such as continuous integration and continuous delivery
Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships and collaborate with stakeholders to drive prioritization across multiple projects
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
Excellent communication, situational awareness, and conflict-resolution skills, with a focus on increasing transparency and alignment across teams
Adaptive, proactive, empathetic, and tenacious approach to problem-solving, with a positive and collaborative mindset

Desired Skills

Project management in a government technology delivery context (state or federal)
Track record of maturing and expanding agile transformation and pursuing best practices in project management with government stakeholders
Experience building and strengthening technical quality assurance processes and/or CI/CD pipelines

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

The CDW Project Manager is a trusted consultant, providing project management expertise across multiple technology stacks and services. Projects are typically of low to medium complexity and incorporate mainstream, legacy and emerging technologies. The Project Manager may independently manage projects, or work within a large program under the guidance of Program Managers. The successful candidate balances scope, schedules, budget and understands how to leverage PMO tools and templates to drive successful business outcomes for the customer. This position works with mixed teams consisting of CDW engineers, CDW sales, other members of CDW cross functional business areas, customer staff, and third-party consultants. The CDW Project Manager is a project advocate and relationship builder. They drive successful engagements through negotiation, concise communication, crucial conversations, and leadership abilities.

What You Will Do

Use experience, skillset, and methodologies to understand the client’s end goals and provide a consultative approach to ensure that the solution provided is appropriate for the client’s desired overall outcome and strategy.
Be a trusted consultant to your project team in all matters related to project delivery, CDW processes, and project management with best practices and delivery. Build relationships with all project stakeholders.
Creates and maintains presence with all project stakeholders, acting as a CDW steward for quality. Dedicated to meeting or exceeding stakeholder expectations. Identifies success criteria and ensures that it is met by involving the stakeholders in key decisions and linking project outcomes to strategic business initiatives.
Recognizes the need for negotiations, gathers relevant information, and seeks advice from sales and management when needed. Negotiates changes (cost, scope, effort, schedule of solution, resource commitment, etc.) to agreeable results. Effective negotiation of changes that achieve stakeholder satisfaction and drive positive project results.
Works with team members to gather information and determine impacts to the project, document mitigation steps taken in troubleshooting, and communicate these to the team and client.
Independently manages medium to large sized projects requiring complex cross functional collaboration and management, adhering to CDW’s project management processes and methodologies.
Accountable for project profitability. Track project budgets and resources and manage actuals vs. planned hours against the resource allocation and budget. Timely reporting of project financials and budgets to stakeholders. Ties project outcomes to clients’ business strategies, helping to generate new business.
Ensures that time, expenses, and invoices are accurately tracked and approved against the project in a timely manner.
Validates initial project scope and estimates. Determine the need for a new Statement of Work versus a Change Order. Makes sellers aware of new opportunities for additional services opportunities uncovered during project delivery.
Ensures all items defined in CDW Statement of Work are delivered and perform quality assurance throughout the lifecycle of the project.
Establishes, monitors, adjusts and communicates tasks and associated schedules to the project team and modifies when necessary. Build project schedules in conjunction with our engineering teams and partner resources.
Aids in identifying proper resources and optimizing billable schedules, monitors and adjusts assignments as necessary to drive client satisfaction and project profitability.
Identify, documents, tracks, and communicate project risks and issues. Strategizes potential resolution and drives desired course of action to bring issues to timely resolution.
Manages equipment, software, licensing and outside services procurement and delivery schedules.
Documents, outcomes, lessons learned and shared appropriately with colleagues. Leverage expertise to help drive business process improvements within the CDW Services PMO.
Take accountability for project results and hold all project team members accountable for their scope of work and schedule commitments. Is fiscally responsible to the client, the project and to CDW.
Instills trust with our clients by building strong relationships with stakeholders.
Uses political savviness, business acumen, and relevant personnel along with CDW experience to establish credibility.
Demonstrates the ability to diffuse uncomfortable situations with client and/or project team.
Leads teams to consistently meet project success factors and exceed client expectations.
Inspects delegated tasks to ensure timely and accurate completion. Coach and mentor Associate Project Managers.
Stays abreast of industry best practices through research, conferences, training seminars and participation in professional associations. Shares information across the Services PMO.
Determines the appropriate documentation (communication plans, schedules/timelines, status reports, quality plan, closure summary, budget, risk plan, etc.) for projects. Manages the quality and delivery of documentation to clients.
Has a clear and concise communication style, leads and facilitates both live and virtual meetings. Keeps meetings on track, on topic and summarizes, assigns and publishes follow up items in a timely manner.
Adapts communication style and medium to the audience's needs. Recognizes when communication efforts are ineffective and adapts tactics and/or medium as necessary.
Effectively prepares and delivers difficult information. Can credibly communicate complex topics to stakeholders and build consensus.
Anticipates client or project needs, communicates potential solutions. Conveys CDW experiences and positive outcomes to build client confidence and trust.
Develop and manage a detailed schedule and work plan.

What We Expect From You

Bachelor’s Degree and 4 years of experience in project management or four years of CDW Services experience OR 8 years of experience in project management or 8 years of CDW Services experience
Two or more years of experience in leading small to medium scale projects in a professional services organization.
Project management or agile consulting experience as it pertains to advising clients of delivery best practices across multiple technology stacks (e.g., Cloud, Security, Infrastructure)
Ability to support presales activities and look for new sales opportunities to help the client achieve organizational goals while growing CDW’s portfolio of work.
Participate productively in virtual teams in order to improve Project Management processes.
Experience Project Managing projects with several technologies.
Demonstrated ability to take accountability for projects and their results, be fiscally responsible and lead teams to meet project success factors.
Working knowledge of one or more formal project management methodologies, proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Project/Office.
Excellent written, presentation, and verbal communication skills including demonstrated experience presenting technology recommendations from a business perspective.
Applies discretion when dealing with sensitive/confidential information.
Ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously and adapt to the changing needs of the business while meeting deadlines.
Ability to work weekends and/or off hours as necessary to meet clients' needs.
Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% or as needed to other CDW locations, meetings and client sites.
Ability to understand, remember, and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information. Ability to organize thoughts and ideas into understandable terminology. Ability to multi-task, organize and prioritize. Ability to apply common sense in performing job. Ability to understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines.
PMP and/or Agile Certification(s), a plus
Experience using both Waterfall and Agile methods (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) to manage projects, a plus

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

Liftpass has been retained by a specialist engineering consultancy with decades of heritage in aviation and logistics, and a reputation for driving and delivering high-value projects in airport infrastructure, baggage handling, cargo and automated materials handling solutions.

This is a client-facing SME role. new_jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview

Program Manager – MEMS Development, BU Sensors in TE Connectivity Transportation Segment – Canada is responsible for driving planning, execution, and delivery of programs supporting MEMS foundries and ecosystem partners. This role coordinates cross-functional execution across Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Product Management, Quality, Finance and Operations.

This is an exciting time to join Sensors Central Technology development team as we expand MEMS portfolio, process capability and functionality. Our MEMS programs require fast execution, close coordination with external manufacturing partners, internal manufacturing sites, and strong connectivity between internal customer requirements, program commitments, and on-the-ground execution. This role will strengthen BU Sensors ability to execute with speed, clarity, and accountability across global teams.

The role requires a hands-on program leader who can operate with agility, curiosity, ownership, and strong follow-through in a fast-changing environment. The successful candidate must be comfortable working through ambiguity, applying prior experience and technical knowledge in MEMS processing, learning new technologies quickly, identifying risks early, and driving actions to closure without waiting for detailed direction.

The Program Manager will support solution-level execution by maintaining program schedules, risks, dependencies, decisions, and action plans. Success requires more than meeting facilitation or status reporting. This role must actively drive alignment, escalate blockades, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and help teams translate ambiguity into actionable and executable plans. At the same time, this role will maintain all internal systems and quality required documentation.

Strong knowledge of MEMS processing and excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required, as this role will regularly interact with issues in MEMS process design and manufacturing, regional and global stakeholders

Job Requirements

Lead planning and execution for assigned MEMS development programs from concept through execution, validation, and SOP.
Close interaction with external MEMS Manufacturing partners (often on site), follow up on process, risks and issues and solution definition together with R&D engineering
Drive accountability and execution with external foundry partners through structured reviews, action tracking, escalation management, and performance monitoring.
Lead weekly operational reviews with foundry partners, ensuring commitments, risks, process changes, and recovery plans are clearly documented and executed.
Develop strong working relationships with foundry engineering and operations teams to proactively identify schedule risks and manufacturing constraints.
Lead development and execution of recovery plans when program milestones are at risk due to process, capacity, yield, equipment, or supply chain constraints.
Track and communicate key performance indicators including schedule adherence, cycle time, wafer starts, yield readiness, validation progress, issue closure rate, and on-time delivery of program milestones.
Build and maintain integrated program schedules using Microsoft Project or other commercial program management.
Monitor and report performance against plans to ensure that contractual, cost and schedule objectives are met; arrange modifications as required and evaluate program effectiveness by collecting and analysing data in support of key performance metrics
Proactively identify risks, gaps, and blockers; drive mitigation plans, recovery actions, and timely escalation where needed.
Drive cross-functional alignment across MEMS Engineering, Product Development Engineering, Product Management, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance and Operations.
Support internal/external customer milestone alignment by connecting their needs with internal execution plans, sample readiness, validation, and manufacturing readiness.
Ensure that activities follow organizational policies, safety, quality and compliance requirements as well as external regulatory and contractual requirements.
Facilitate effective program reviews and working sessions focused on decisions, actions, blockers, and next steps.
Prepare clear program updates, dashboards, risk summaries, and executive-level status readouts.
Communicate clearly and professionally in English with global internal and external stakeholders.
Build trusted working relationships across functions, regions, and sites to improve execution speed, transparency, and accountability.

What Your Background Should Look Like

10+ years of experience in MEMS processing, CMOS or similar semiconductor manufacturing
5+ years of experience in program management, technical/ engineering program management, manufacturing program management, or related roles; 7+ years preferred.
B.S. in Engineering or related technical field is required. M.S./ Ph. D degree preferred.
PMP, Agile, Scrum, Lean, Design for Six Sigma, or equivalent certification preferred.
Proven track record of driving cross-functional teams to deliver measurable results, not simply documenting status or meeting notes
Willing to come often to the external manufacturing sites to review status, identify process problems and plan improvement activities.
Good understanding of APQP, PPAP, FMEA and SPC is required.
Hands-on experience with MS Project or other commercial program management tools.
Strong understanding of advanced product development (APD), new product introduction (NPI), Product Validation, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp processes.
Solid experience in developing MEMS process for automotive market and AEC-Q103 requirements and qualifications.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and aggressive customer timelines.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

About Te Connectivity

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal.
That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

This is a remote position supporting a major retail client. Candidates are required to be available during Pacific Standard Time business hours and support onsite events as needed. Candidates located in the San Francisco Bay Area are strongly preferred.

The Health & Wellbeing Program Manager is a client-dedicated member of the Personify Health account team, focused on designing and delivering a comprehensive strategic wellbeing plan, aimed at building a culture of health, enhancing health and wellbeing engagement, and driving health behavior change through awareness and activation. The Health & Wellbeing Program Manager works side by side with the Personify Health account leadership and the client’s HR, benefits, and/or stakeholder teams. This individual will provide advocacy for Personify Health products while embracing Personify Health’s mission and values. This position may include approximately 10-15% travel.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities/Duties

Provide direction and subject matter expertise in defining, designing, developing, communicating, and executing a comprehensive health and wellbeing strategy
Utilize project management skills to develop and execute health and wellbeing programs according to timeline and budget
Monitor, evaluate, and respond to program measurements and participant feedback, including operations and quality, to drive continuous quality improvement initiatives and goals
Serve as an integrated partner and the face of wellbeing to the client population, guiding members to appropriate resources and programs

This role offers the opportunity to manage the lifecycle of engineered products after their initial release, ensuring revisions are coordinated, documented, and implemented effectively.

You will work across Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Service, Project Management, Quality, and external partners to keep complex product changes moving forward.

The position combines program coordination, configuration management, documentation oversight, and cross-functional communication.

You will maintain visibility into scope, dependencies, ownership, milestones, risks, and release readiness across multiple concurrent revisions.

Your work will help ensure product changes are implemented accurately while keeping technical, manufacturing, customer, and service requirements aligned.

This is a fully remote role suited to an organized, proactive professional who thrives in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Accountabilities

Manage programs for released products, including major revisions, performance and configuration updates, compliance-driven changes, manufacturing changes, and documentation-impacting updates.
Develop and maintain revision plans covering scope, affected products and configurations, deliverables, owners, dependencies, milestones, and implementation status.
Lead recurring cross-functional meetings, including agendas, status updates, decisions, action items, and follow-through to closure.
Monitor program schedules, scope, risks, dependencies, and readiness while identifying gaps and escalating decisions or resource needs.

Support cut-in planning and communication so teams understand which revision applies, when it takes effect, and which deliverables are required.
Maintain dashboards, trackers, meeting records, and decision logs to provide clear visibility into progress and accountability.
Report progress, upcoming milestones, risks, overdue actions, and required decisions to Product Development leadership and relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate handoffs between Product Development and Operations, including readiness reviews and completion criteria.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Business, Project Management, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years of experience in program or project coordination, product lifecycle support, engineering change coordination, production planning, or a related role involving engineered or manufactured products.
Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Project Management, Quality, Service, and suppliers or contract manufacturers.
Experience with revision control, engineering change processes, documentation workflows, or configuration management in a quality-driven manufacturing environment.
Strong program coordination and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple product revisions and competing priorities.
Highly organized, with the ability to maintain clear scope, ownership, dependencies, milestones, risks, decisions, and action status.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including meeting facilitation, status reporting, stakeholder coordination, and escalation.

Self-directed, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in fast-changing, cross-functional environments.

Full-time opportunity reporting to the Director of Product Development.

Flexibility and autonomy to execute responsibilities and manage programs effectively.

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Build the foundations of a once-in-a-generation AI-native company

monō ai exists to make organisations AI-native — so people and businesses can achieve what was never possible before. The gap between AI-native companies at the frontier and the rest of the market is not primarily a technology gap. It is an operating-model gap. Most organisations need to fundamentally rewire how they work, decide and deliver.
This is what we are building monō ai to do. We sit inside client teams, build real systems on their infrastructure and prove value in weeks - not with a roadmap, but with working capability.
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on operator to join us in Australia and help build the foundations of the company itself.

The role

As Business Operations Manager
, you will run and improve the day-to-day operating systems of monō ai across people operations, revenue and commercial operations, internal technology and systems, and finance support. This is a broad, practical role: you will keep important workflows working reliably while finding better ways to run them as the business grows.
You will move between the big picture and the detail. One day you may be making a new starter's onboarding seamless; the next you may be redesigning a core internal process into an AI-first, repeatable playbook. You will own agreed priorities end to end, work closely with the people accountable for decisions in each area, and know when to bring in specialist support. You are not expected to be a COO or a proxy for the CEO's Chief of Staff.
﻿

What you will do

The remit spans the areas below. You will agree priorities with the COO and work with the relevant leads on decisions that sit with their teams.
People operations and team enablement
·   Coordinate and improve hiring operations, from role briefs and candidate processes through interviews, references, offers and onboarding, in partnership with hiring managers and leadership.
·   Own the operational experience of joining, moving within and leaving the company, ensuring people, information, equipment and access are ready at the right time; maintaining an awesome employee experience throughout.
·   Maintain accurate people records, documentation, policies and onboarding materials; identify gaps and work with the appropriate owners to address them.
·   Coordinate team rhythms, meetings, offsites, travel and internal communications where needed.
·   Identify and remove recurring blockers so the team can do its best work.
·   Design and implement AI-powered workflows to improve key people processes where practical and appropriate.
·   Contribute to a culture of ownership, care, speed and continuous improvement.
Technology and systems operations
·   Become a capable user of monō ai's platform, understand our internal systems landscape and work with leadership to improve how our tools and AI-powered workflows support the business.
·   Coordinate IT setup for new starters, including devices, accounts, access permissions and core software.
·   Maintain accurate records of hardware, software, licences, users and access rights.
·   Administer and improve the internal tools that help the team work securely and effectively, applying sensible access and documentation practices.
·   Triage day-to-day technology issues, resolve practical problems and escalate specialist matters appropriately.
This is internal systems administration and first-line support, not a specialist engineering or cybersecurity role. You do not need to be an IT specialist, but you should be comfortable learning new systems, managing access carefully and helping solve practical problems.
Revenue and commercial operations
·   Keep CRM, pipeline and opportunity information accurate and useful; coordinate opportunity tracking, meeting preparation and follow-up with the GTM team as required. This includes holding the GTM team accountable for their own data quality.
·   Coordinate proposals, statements of work, order forms and client onboarding so the relevant people, information and approvals come together on time.
·   Track commitments, next steps and commercial actions, following through so nothing important falls between teams.
·   Build and improve repeatable GTM workflows, using automation and AI-first approaches where they make the work more reliable or efficient.
·   Work with commercial and delivery teams to improve handoffs and turn effective ways of working into repeatable processes.
Finance and other operations
·   Support the finance function with operational work as required, including supplier cost tracking, maintaining reliable inputs and records, and finance systems and projects support (for example budgeting support for company events and/or systems upgrades or workflows).
·   Support the company’s compliance activities, helping the team ensure our SOC2 obligations are met through reliable people operations, IT ops and supporting SOC2 audits via project management and coordinating evidence collation.
·   Be a force-multiplier for our culture – bringing energy, drive and enjoyment to team, along with a ‘can do’ mindset

What success looks like

In your first 30 days
·   You understand how monō ai works, who owns key decisions and where the main operational friction sits.
·   You have built a working understanding of monō ai's platform and are using it to improve your day-to-day work.
·   You have built trust across the team as someone who follows through and exercises good judgement.
·   Core operational information is organised, current and easy to find.
·   You have taken ownership of several immediate priorities and closed them properly.
In your first 90 days
·   The team has greater confidence in the reliability and visibility of its core operating information.
·   You are using monō ai's platform confidently and have improved its organisational knowledge, adoption or use in business operations where it is useful.
·   Key people, commercial, technology and administrative workflows have clear owners, sensible controls and fewer points of friction.
·   Several recurring processes have been simplified, documented or automated, with tangible time or quality improvements.
·   You have become a force multiplier for the team — not by creating more process, but by making the right work easier to do.
Over time
·   monō ai has an operating foundation that can scale without unnecessary bureaucracy.
·   The team spends less time chasing information and more time building, selling and delivering.
·   Important commitments are visible, owned and completed.
·   The business runs with increasing velocity, intelligence, capacity and experience.

What we are looking for

You may come from operations, consulting, professional services, finance, technology, a startup, a high-growth company or another demanding environment. The exact background matters less than what you have taken responsibility for and improved.
We are looking for someone who:
·   Has independently owned recurring business operations or cross-functional workflows, improved how they run and can show what changed as a result.
·   Has exceptional drive, high standards and the discipline to finish what they start.
·   Leans into AI-first thinking, is curious about how businesses work and learns quickly across unfamiliar topics.
·   Can move between detailed administration and broader business questions, form a view and recommend a practical next step.
·   Thinks in systems, notices what is missing, takes responsibility and builds processes a small team will actually use.
·   Is organised, diligent and dependable with sensitive information and competing priorities.
·   Communicates clearly, builds strong relationships and brings sound judgement to ambiguity - with the humility to listen and the confidence to challenge constructively.
You do not need to be a specialist in every area. Experience across several of the following will help you succeed:
·   Startup, scale-up or professional-services operations.
·   HR / People operations, recruitment coordination or onboarding.
·   Accounting, finance administration or management reporting.
·   Project management and cross-functional delivery.
·   Internal systems administration, CRM, revenue operations, commercial administration or using AI and other tools to improve workflow execution.

Important context

This is a high-ownership role in an early-stage company. The work will be varied, fast-moving and occasionally messy. You will be trusted to bring structure to ambiguity, do the practical work yourself and work with colleagues to get decisions made. You will not need to own every company decision to have a material impact on how the business runs.
If you thrive in fast-paced, highly innovative environments and want to contribute broadly, improve next-generation systems and help create the foundations of a company with genuine ambition, we would love to hear from you.

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. new_jobs.description:
You have experience investigating security alerts and incidents, and you want to work on the issues behind them too: clearer procedures, a stronger incident response plan and fewer recurring risks.
For an international manufacturing organisation in the Waasland region, we are looking for an IT Security Analyst who will also help bring its security measures and documentation relating to NIS2 up to standard.

An external SOC partner monitors the IT environment 24/7. You investigate the alerts it raises, determine what action is needed and follow incidents through to resolution. You will also have the opportunity to improve the organisation’s cybersecurity more broadly.

What will you do?
Analyse security alerts:
identify false positives, decide what needs further investigation and recognise when immediate action is required.
Follow up on security incidents with the external SOC partner
and your IT colleagues. Afterwards, you look at how similar incidents can be prevented.
Further develop the incident response plan and help test it.
Create security policies and procedures
, improve existing practices and keep the documentation clear and usable.
Help translate NIS2 requirements
into concrete measures. You assess what is already in place, identify gaps and document the steps taken.
Work in a predominantly Microsoft-based environment, where Microsoft Defender and Intune are key tools.
Contribute to security awareness
among employees.

You will support several international sites in a hybrid IT environment with on-premises infrastructure and cloud applications. Within the IT team, you will be the person dedicated to cybersecurity. You will work independently while collaborating closely with your IT colleagues and the external SOC partner.

What do you bring?
Several years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity
, for example in a SOC or a role involving the investigation of security alerts
and incidents.
The ability to assess an alert from a technical perspective, involve the right people and document the follow-up clearly.
A working knowledge of NIS2
and the motivation to help turn its requirements into security measures, procedures and documentation.
Experience with Microsoft Defender and/or Intune, or with comparable security tools.

An interest in looking beyond individual incidents to improve processes and security measures.
The ability to work independently and collaborate with colleagues across IT.
Good English communication skills
, as English is the working language of the international team. Dutch is an advantage.

Knowledge of Taegis, GDPR or ISO 27001 is a plus. You do not need to have covered every aspect of this broad role already. Practical security experience, a solid technical foundation and a willingness to learn matter most.

What can you expect?

You will receive a permanent contract and work on site in the Waasland region. After the onboarding period, you can generally work from home three days a week.
Working hours are flexible, and there are opportunities to develop your cybersecurity skills further.
Your salary package will depend on your experience. It includes meal vouchers, hospitalisation and pension insurance, a bonus plan and the option to lease a bicycle.
A cafeteria plan is planned for the future.
A company car is not included.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Field Service Utilization & Productivity
new_jobs.description:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

A shop creates value when technician time becomes completed, high-quality repair work. That conversion depends on more than technician effort. Work must be ready, parts and tools must be available, assignments must match skill, bays must turn, and handoffs must happen without avoidable waiting.

As Sr. Program Manager, Field Service Utilization & Productivity, you will build the tools, standards, and operating processes that help service centers make the best use of every available hour. You will study how work moves through the shop, identify why productive time is lost, and give Field leaders practical systems that improve utilization, productivity, and throughput.

The goal is sustainable performance. The system must protect repair quality, customer commitments, safety, training, breaks, and a workable pace for team members. Field leaders will run the daily shop and coach individuals; you will build the network operating system that makes strong performance repeatable.

Responsibilities

This is What You'll Do

Build the shop utilization system

Create decision tools for the shop: Partner with Service Digital and Analytics to build ServiceOS views, ready-work queues, dispatch boards, and dashboards that show utilization, productivity, efficiency, throughput, work mix, and lost-time causes together.
Design the daily management process: Give Service Operations Managers and Production Supervisors a clear routine for reviewing available hours, ready work, skill coverage, bay and tool constraints, parts status, emerging bottlenecks, and recovery actions.
Diagnose the system around the technician: Use field observation, time studies, work-order data, clocking data, and technician feedback to separate demand gaps, poor work readiness, parts waits, tool constraints, skill mismatch, dispatch delays, excessive handoffs, and data defects.
Diagnose and route readiness failures: Identify released work that still lacks repair scope, authorization, parts, tools, diagnostic clarity, or the right technician capability.
Turn field practice into network tools: Find service centers that produce strong output without sacrificing quality or people, verify the operating cause, and convert the practice into a tool, routine, or playbook that other sites can adopt.

Protect people, quality, and customers

Set sustainable-performance guardrails: Treat training, breaks, safety work, coaching, and shop care as necessary operating time. Build standards that reduce true waste without turning every non-repair minute into a performance defect.
Balance output with repair quality: Read utilization and productivity alongside efficiency, work mix, rework, repair quality, and vehicle dwell. Stop changes that create speed by shifting defects, unfinished work, or avoidable pressure downstream.
Watch the human signals: Partner with Field leadership and People to monitor overtime, workload balance, missed breaks, training displacement, turnover signals, and frontline feedback. Adjust the operating model when the performance system creates an unsustainable pace.

This Is What You'll Need

7+ years improving service, production, or shop operations: You have redesigned how work is prepared, assigned, executed, and handed off in an automotive, manufacturing, maintenance, logistics, field-service, or similarly complex operating environment.
Deep utilization and productivity fluency: You understand how utilization, productivity, efficiency, throughput, work mix, quality, and customer access interact. You know why a single metric can misdiagnose the shop.
Workflow and tool-building experience: You have turned operating problems into practical workflows, dashboards, decision tools, standard work, or digital requirements that frontline leaders use.
Shop-floor credibility: You learn by watching the work and listening to technicians, supervisors, advisors, and parts teams. You can distinguish a dashboard signal from the physical cause inside the shop.
Human-centered operating judgment: You can improve output while protecting safety, training, breaks, workload balance, and repair quality. You recognize when a productivity intervention is creating hidden cost through fatigue, rework, or turnover.
Cross-functional program leadership: You can move a shop-performance system through Field Service, Service Digital, Service Parts Operations, Technical Service Operations, People, Learning & Development, and Business Insights without taking daily control away from Field leaders.

Qualifications

This is Who You Are

The Shop Flow Architect: You see ready work, technician skill, bays, tools, parts, and handoffs as one operating system. You design the conditions that let good work move without friction.
The Lost-Time Detective: You trace idle time to its operating cause before assigning blame. The answer may be dispatch, parts, tools, work readiness, training, or demand, and you follow the evidence to the source.
A Field Systems Builder: You turn what works in one shop into a tool or routine that can survive in many. The field can use what you build during a real production day.
A Sustainable-Performance Advocate: You believe strong output and a healthy team must reinforce each other. You remove waste while protecting the time people need to work safely, learn, recover, and maintain quality.
The Customer Advocate: You refuse productivity gains that create rushed repairs, repeat visits, missed commitments, or poor communication. The work must be faster because the system is better.

Stay current on relevant codes and standards (e.g., ASHRAE, NEC, NYS Energy Code), NYSERDA and utility program requirements, the NYS Technical Resource Manual (TRM), and emerging electrification and building technologies.

New York State Professional Engineer (PE) license required; Certified Energy Manager (CEM) and/or Building Commissioning Professional (BCxP) preferred.

Experience performing electrical load calculation analyses (using HOMER, EasyPower, or equivalent) and submitting utility service upgrade requests, including MCID and load letters.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Partner with product and data teams to determine appropriate verification approaches for different markets, including facial verification, ID scanning, phone verification, and other methods.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases, and identify opportunities to make the review process more efficient and effective.
Identify gaps in available fraud signals and assess third-party tools or solutions that could strengthen the product roadmap.
Translate analytical findings into practical recommendations and operational fraud controls.

new_jobs.title: Post-Production Project Manager, Photo
new_jobs.description:
We’re looking for a highly organized, solutions-oriented Post-Production Project Manager, Photo to oversee the end-to-end photo post-production workflow across our Retouching Team.

Sitting within Brand Operations, this role will serve as the central liaison between Retouching, Project Management, Art Direction, Design, Production and internal and external partners. This person will own retouching operations, resource planning, timelines, agency coordination and digital asset management, ensuring assets move efficiently from capture through retouching, approval, delivery and archival.

The ideal candidate understands both the creative and operational sides of post-production and can anticipate bottlenecks, establish scalable workflows and provide visibility across all active campaigns and launches.

What You’ll Do

Post-Production & Retouching Operations

Own the end-to-end post-production workflow across eCommerce, campaign, editorial, retail, social and marketing photography.
Manage projects from photography handoff through retouching, approvals, final delivery and archival.
Build schedules aligned with campaign and launch calendars while maintaining visibility across all active workstreams.
Ensure assets are delivered accurately, efficiently and in line with creative and brand standards.

Capacity & Resource Planning

Maintain a centralized view of internal retoucher, freelancer and agency workloads.
Forecast resource needs based on upcoming shoots, launches and asset volume.
Balance assignments across internal and external resources based on complexity, timing and capacity.
Identify bottlenecks early and recommend additional resources or priority adjustments when needed.
Ensure high-priority projects do not unintentionally compromise other active workstreams.

Timeline & Dependency Management

Establish post-production milestones, handoff dates and delivery expectations for every project.
Track dependencies including image selects, shot lists, retouching notes, creative direction, product information and approvals.
Follow up with upstream teams and escalate late inputs that may affect delivery.
Partner with stakeholders to adjust scope, resources, priorities or timing when schedules become compressed.
Ensure post-production needs are considered during initial project planning.

Cross-Functional Project Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for photo post-production across Creative and cross-functional teams.
Partner with Art Directors, Producers, Photographers, Project Managers, Marketing and other stakeholders.
Establish clear ownership of selects, retouching notes, asset preparation, approvals and delivery.
Create visibility across Project Managers so the full post-production workload can be evaluated holistically.
Communicate project status, risks, priorities and resource needs to creative leadership.
Keep retouchers focused on skilled creative work by minimizing unnecessary administrative tasks.

Retouching & Agency Management

Manage work across internal retouchers, freelancers and external agencies.
Determine which projects should remain in-house or be outsourced based on creative complexity, volume, timing and capacity.
Coordinate agency handoffs, including selects, briefs, references, retouching notes and delivery expectations.
Track progress, revisions, approvals, final delivery and external partner utilization.
Support the onboarding and management of new post-production partners.

Digital Asset Management

Own the organization and lifecycle of creative assets from ingestion through delivery and archival.
Establish and maintain file naming conventions, folder structures, metadata, taxonomy and version control standards.
Ensure approved assets are uploaded, tagged, organized and searchable within Dropbox and GlobalEdit.
Maintain clear distinctions between working files, review files, approved masters and final deliverables.
Manage outdated, duplicate or incorrect versions to prevent improper asset use.
Oversee asset permissions, access and distribution across internal teams and external partners.
Partner with Creative, Marketing, eCommerce and other teams to make assets easy to locate and use.
Maintain records of campaign associations, product information, usage rights and expiration dates where applicable.
Establish archival standards and support the cleanup, migration and optimization of existing asset libraries.
Serve as a key resource for questions about asset location, availability, organization and usage.

Workflow & Process Optimization

Build scalable workflows connecting photography, retouching, digital asset management and final distribution.
Develop and maintain SOPs, templates, briefing tools, tracking systems and documentation.
Identify inefficient manual processes and implement improved solutions.
Evaluate automation and AI-assisted opportunities across post-production and asset management.
Continuously improve communication and handoffs across Creative, Production, Retouching, Project Management and downstream teams.

Quality Control & Final Delivery

Ensure assets complete all required creative and technical approvals before release.
Partner with retouching leadership to maintain consistent quality across internal and external work.
Confirm final assets meet channel specifications and maintain version control through revisions.
Ensure approved assets are properly delivered and archived.
Identify recurring quality or workflow issues and implement preventative solutions.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of experience in creative project management, post-production, photography production, retouching operations, digital asset management or a related field.
Experience managing high-volume creative asset pipelines across multiple simultaneous campaigns.
Strong understanding of photography, retouching, post-production and digital asset workflows.
Experience with DAM platforms, metadata, taxonomy, naming conventions, version control and archival practices.
Experience managing freelancers, agencies and external creative partners.
Exceptional organizational, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to balance creative priorities with operational requirements.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to high creative standards.
Ability to anticipate challenges and develop solutions in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience within fashion, apparel, lifestyle, beauty, retail or consumer brands.
Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and Photoshop-based post-production workflows.
Experience with project management platforms such as Asana, Monday.com, Airtable, Smartsheet or Wrike.
Hands-on experience with Dropbox, GlobalEdit or similar enterprise DAM systems.
Understanding of image specifications, color management, file formats and digital production best practices.
Experience implementing workflow automation or AI-assisted creative production tools.

FIGS Compensation And Benefits

Pay Range

At FIGS, your base salary is one part of your total compensation package. This role's base salary range is between $110,000 and $130,000. Actual base salary is determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to your relevant skills, qualifications, and years of experience.

Additional Compensation And Benefits

Equity: Eligible FIGS employees have the opportunity to own shares of FIGS stock through our new-hire equity program. Additionally, FIGS provides a discount when purchasing FIGS stock voluntarily through our FIGS Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Annual bonus: This position is eligible to participate in the FIGS annual bonus program
Other compensation and benefits offered include:
Comprehensive benefits and perks package focused on your well-being, including premium medical, dental and vision coverage, and full access to wellness services through Breethe and Classpass. 100% FIGS-sponsored life insurance and disability insurance
Amazing 401(k) program, with a company match up to the first 6% of your contribution
Generous paid time off - We have 12 company holidays. For salaried team members, we offer flexible vacation. For our hourly team members, we offer up to 3 weeks of accrued vacation
Meaningful time away for baby bonding, including parental leave, new parent care meals, and a transition back to work for primary caregivers
FIGS sponsored Uber Eats voucher for in-office weeks
Personalized discount code for 50% off all FIGS products, along with a separate code to share with family and friends to enjoy a 25% discount site-wide
Access to FIGS Vet, Discounted Pet Daycare, Discounted Pet Insurance, and so much more…
Benefits eligibility is determined by hour requirements and length of service

A Little Bit About Us…

FIGS, Inc. is a founder-led, direct-to-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand that seeks to celebrate, empower and serve current and future generations of healthcare professionals. We redefine what scrubs are by creating technically advanced apparel and products that feature an unmatched combination of comfort, durability, function and style, all at an affordable price. With the largest DTC platform in healthcare apparel, we sell our products to a rapidly growing community of loyal customers. Through these customer relationships, FIGS has built a community and lifestyle around a profession, revolutionizing the large and fragmented healthcare apparel market and becoming the industry’s category-defining healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand.

Our Threads for Threads initiative is integral to our mission to improve the lives of healthcare professionals on a global scale. Founded alongside FIGS in 2013, Threads for Threads donates scrubs to healthcare professionals working in resource-poor countries around the world.

FIGS considers all Qualified Applicants, including those with Criminal Histories (e.g., arrests or conviction records), for Employment in accordance with applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

new_jobs.title: Benefits Program Manager (LATAM, Canada & Global Wellbeing)
new_jobs.description:
At Nutanix, our people are our most critical asset, and we believe in taking care of them so they can do their best work. We are looking for a Benefits Program Manager to take primary ownership of our Benefits plans across LATAM and Canada, while also driving Global Wellbeing programs.

This role is ideal for an experienced benefits professional who balances strategic planning with day-to-day execution to improve the employee experience. You'll own complex regional programs, identify opportunities to improve and scale how we deliver benefits, and influence decisions through data, insights, and deep subject matter expertise.

What You Will Do

Own Regional Benefits: Design, manage, and continuously evolve core benefits programs across LATAM and Canada, aligning with Nutanix’s global Total Rewards philosophy. Execute renewal strategies, drive vendor optimization, improve operational process, and handle complex policy and program updates.
Advance Global Wellbeing Programs: Enhance global wellbeing programs to support employees' overall wellbeing. Hands on management of program operations, reporting, engaging communications, enablement, and governance. Partner cross-functionally to integrate wellbeing into the broader employee experience.
Drive Strategic Program Improvements: Evaluate benefits and wellbeing programs to identify opportunities to better support employees and meet changing business needs. Use data, feedback, and market trends to recommend and implement improvements that enhance the employee experience and program effectiveness.
Manage Complex Projects: Drive and execute complex, cross-functional projects requiring coordination across the business.
Optimize and Scale: Manage external partners and vendors end-to-end, holding them accountable on service levels, proactively addressing operational issues, and leading vendor selections or RFPs when needed.
Build Connection & Growth: Core team member of the AMER benefits team with a key role in the U.S. open enrollment project. Partner closely with internal stakeholders in support other U.S. benefit programs and projects as needed.

How You Will Work & Make An Impact

Autonomy & Judgement: Operate with minimal guidance. Solve ambiguous problems with multiple trade-offs and balance business, financial, and people outcomes effectively.
Data-Driven Strategy: Focus on applying data insights to drive strategy and decision-making.
Influence & Alignment: Align stakeholders with competing priorities. Frame problems and solutions clearly, advising with synthesized data, options, and a grounded point of view.

What You Bring

Experience: 7+ years of progressive benefits program management experience, including direct experience managing regional benefit plans. Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion and according to policy and law. Proficiency across multiple business software tools.
Benefits Expertise: Solid understanding of international benefits administration, vendor management, compliance, and strategy, along with experience navigating regional differences across multiple countries.
Wellbeing Expertise: Demonstrated strategic mindset to expand and scale impact-driven multi-country corporate wellbeing initiatives, with the drive to adapt and optimize engagement strategies across global regions.
Communication & Influence: Ability to translate complex topics into clear, engaging messaging for diverse audiences across the organization and aligning stakeholders with competing priorities. Experience
Analytical Mindset: Advanced experience in combining complex data points from various sources for easy understanding, conducting audits, and translating metrics into clear executive narratives.
Curious Approach: Actively seeks to understand the "why" behind outcomes, questioning assumptions, and exploring whether there is a better way to improve programs, processes, and the employee experience. Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
Project & Change Management: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, end-to-end projects, maintaining processes and procedures with minimal supervision while driving cross-functional alignment.
Languages: Ability to speak Spanish a plus.

Work Arrangement

Hybrid:
This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager. This role is also available remotely.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $121,000 and USD $ 241,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.
